title: Thought calibration: Efficient and confident test-time scaling
authors_zh: Menghua Wu、Cai Zhou、Stephen Bates、Tommi Jaakkola（机构：Massachusetts Institute of Technology）
paper_type_zh: 面向测试时推理的校准早停研究（EMNLP 2025）
best_for_zh: 希望减少推理 token 成本并显式控制提前终止风险的读者。
one_line: Thought calibration uses lightweight hidden-state probes and risk control to stop a reasoning trace once further thought is unlikely to add useful work.
Thought calibration 利用隐藏状态上的轻量探针与风险控制，在进一步思考不太可能带来新信息时终止推理轨迹。
why: It treats “when to stop thinking” as a measurable and calibrated test-time budget decision rather than a fixed length heuristic.
inclusion_reason: It makes the stopping point of a growing thought trace an explicitly calibrated test-time compute allocation decision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models often improve by producing more thought tokens, but a fixed long budget wastes compute on easy instances and a fixed short budget can cut off a difficult solution. Simple length limits do not distinguish productive revision from repetition, so they can reduce accuracy sharply. The useful decision is not how many tokens a model can produce in general, but whether the current partial reasoning is still adding information that can change the answer.

This paper asks when a running thought trace can be stopped with controlled risk. It treats the growing trace as a nested reasoning tree: each generated segment may add a new branch, revisit one, or backtrack. The decision record contains a prompt, current thought prefix, hidden representations, probe outputs, candidate stopping threshold, token count, final answer, and task result. The aim is to stop only once novel reasoning has plateaued, rather than applying an identical cap to every problem.

推理模型往往通过生成更多思考 token 改善表现，但固定的长预算会在简单实例上浪费计算，固定的短预算又可能截断困难问题的解答。简单的长度限制无法区分有成效的修订与重复，因此可能显著降低准确率。有用的决策不是模型一般能产生多少 token，而是当前部分推理是否仍在加入会改变答案的信息。

本文研究怎样以受控风险停止正在运行的思考轨迹。它把不断增长的轨迹视为嵌套推理树：每个生成片段可能增加新分支、重访已有分支或回退。决策记录包含提示、当前思考前缀、隐藏表示、探针输出、候选停止阈值、token 数、最终答案和任务结果。目标是在新推理已经趋于平台时才停止，而不是对每个问题使用同一上限。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Thought calibration interprets an extended chain of thought as a reasoning tree whose growth represents novel computation. If later tokens only walk within or repeatedly revise an established structure, further continuation may have little value. Lightweight probes over hidden states estimate reasoning structure and response consistency without requiring a separate external language-model judge. The system therefore bases a serving decision on information present during generation, not on a post-hoc inspection of a completed trace.

The method then calibrates the stopping rule rather than trusting raw probe confidence. Using Learn-then-Test, it frames possible thresholds as multiple hypothesis tests and selects a rule that controls the risk associated with early termination under its assumptions. This connects the probe, a user-chosen risk level, and the final token allocation. The contribution is consequently an online compute policy: spend another thought segment only while the calibrated evidence indicates meaningful reasoning growth.

Thought calibration 将延长的思维链解释为推理树，其增长代表新的计算。如果后续 token 只是在既有结构中行走或反复修订，继续生成的价值可能很小。隐藏状态上的轻量探针估计推理结构和响应一致性，无需单独的外部语言模型判分器。因此，系统基于生成过程中的信息做服务决策，而不是对已完成轨迹进行事后检查。

随后，该方法校准停止规则，而不信任原始探针置信度。借助 Learn-then-Test，它把可能阈值表述为多重假设检验，并在假设条件下选择控制提前终止风险的规则。这将探针、用户指定的风险水平和最终 token 分配连接起来。因此，其贡献是一种在线计算策略：只有在校准证据表明推理仍有意义地增长时，才花费下一段思考。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors monitor a model’s hidden representations as it generates a reasoning trace and train lightweight probes to characterize whether the implied reasoning tree is still changing. At generation steps, these features are converted into an online stop decision. Unlike post-hoc confidence filtering, the rule can actively terminate decoding before the full default thought budget is used. Learn-then-Test calibrates thresholds on a calibration set and supplies finite-sample, distribution-free risk control for the stated decision setting.

The paper considers DeepSeek-R1-distilled Qwen 32B and Llama 70B models plus QwQ 32B. It first uses held-out s1K-1.1 data for in-distribution calibration, then studies transfer to AIME24, GPQA Diamond, and MATH500. A faithful run must record the base-model revision and hidden-state layer, probe features and training split, allowable risk, calibrated threshold, token trace, stop point, answer extraction, benchmark correctness, and latency. It should compare against both full generation and naïve token caps at matched accuracy targets.

作者在模型生成推理轨迹时监控隐藏表示，并训练轻量探针刻画隐含推理树是否仍在变化。在生成步骤中，这些特征被转换为在线停止决策。不同于事后置信度筛选，该规则能在用完完整默认思考预算之前主动终止解码。Learn-then-Test 在校准集上校准阈值，并为所述决策设置提供有限样本、分布无关的风险控制。

论文考察 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏的 Qwen 32B 和 Llama 70B 模型，以及 QwQ 32B。它先在保留的 s1K-1.1 数据上进行分布内校准，再研究向 AIME24、GPQA Diamond 和 MATH500 的迁移。忠实运行必须记录基础模型修订版与隐藏层、探针特征和训练划分、允许风险、校准阈值、token 轨迹、停止点、答案提取、基准正确性和延迟，并应在匹配准确率目标下与完整生成和朴素 token 上限比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across three reasoning language models and four datasets, the paper reports that thought calibration can preserve model performance while reducing thinking tokens by up to 60% on in-distribution data. On distribution-shift evaluation with AIME24, GPQA Diamond, and MATH500, it reports token reductions of up to 20%. The comparison is important because the baseline is not simply a shorter answer: naïve token limits are described as producing marked accuracy loss, whereas calibrated stopping aims to selectively remove low-value continuation.

The evidence also bounds the claim. The out-of-distribution reduction is smaller than the in-distribution result, and the guarantee concerns the calibrated decision setup rather than universal accuracy preservation for any model or dataset. The paper states that in its worst reported case the policy is no less efficient than naïve budget constraints. These results support an adaptive early-stop policy, but its practical value depends on accessible hidden states, valid calibration data, probe overhead, and whether the deployment distribution resembles the calibration conditions.

在三个推理语言模型和四个数据集上，论文报告 Thought calibration 最多可减少 60% 的分布内思考 token，同时保持模型表现。在 AIME24、GPQA Diamond 和 MATH500 的分布偏移评估上，它报告最多减少 20% token。比较很重要，因为基线不是简单地缩短回答：朴素 token 限制被描述为会造成明显准确率损失，而校准停止旨在选择性移除低价值的继续生成。

证据也限定了主张。分布外减少幅度小于分布内结果，保证涉及的是校准后的决策设置，而非任何模型或数据集都能普适保持准确率。论文指出，在所报告的最差情形下，该策略至少不会比朴素预算限制更低效。这些结果支持自适应早停策略，但其实际价值取决于能否访问隐藏状态、是否存在有效校准数据、探针开销，以及部署分布是否接近校准条件。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier approaches often use a fixed length, train a model to be shorter, or score a completed trace with an external judge. This paper changes the operational question to an online risk-controlled stopping decision. Its reasoning-tree view turns “more thinking” into a structural process: extra tokens are useful only if they grow or substantially revise the current tree. Hidden-state probes supply a lightweight signal before the model has finished generating.

The distinctive contribution is calibration of the action to stop, not merely calibration of a score. By applying Learn-then-Test to thresholds, the method expresses a token-saving decision in terms of an explicit risk budget. It does not prove that hidden reasoning trees faithfully represent semantic reasoning, nor eliminate distribution shift. Its reusable insight is that early stopping should be compared as a budget policy with quantified failure risk, rather than as a generic length-reduction heuristic.

先前方法通常使用固定长度、训练模型变短，或用外部判分器对完成轨迹评分。本论文把操作性问题改为在线、风险受控的停止决策。其推理树观点把“更多思考”转化为结构过程：只有当额外 token 增长或实质修订当前树时才有用。隐藏状态探针会在模型完成生成前提供轻量信号。

独特贡献是校准停止这一动作，而不只是校准一个分数。通过对阈值应用 Learn-then-Test，方法以明确风险预算表达节省 token 的决策。它并未证明隐藏推理树忠实代表语义推理，也未消除分布偏移。可复用的洞见是，早停应作为带量化失败风险的预算策略来比较，而不是作为通用的长度缩减启发式规则。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach requires white-box access to hidden states and adds probe computation, so it is not directly applicable to a black-box reasoning API or necessarily free in latency. Its risk control rests on calibration assumptions and a chosen loss definition; distribution shift, changes in prompting or model revision, and different answer parsers can invalidate the empirical relation between probe signals and useful continuation. It also measures whether reasoning has plateaued, not whether the current answer is correct. A careful deployment must therefore recalibrate after material model or task changes and retain a conservative fallback for high-risk queries.
该方法需要对白盒隐藏状态的访问，并增加探针计算，因此不能直接应用于黑盒推理接口，也未必在延迟上免费。其风险控制依赖校准假设和选定损失定义；分布偏移、提示或模型修订版变化以及不同答案解析器，都可能使探针信号与有用继续生成之间的经验关系失效。它测量的是推理是否趋于平台，而不是当前答案是否正确。因此，谨慎的部署必须在模型或任务发生实质变化后重新校准，并为高风险查询保留保守的后备策略。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when the serving system owns a reasoning model and must convert a quality target into a token-saving policy. Log the model revision, prompt family, every evaluated thought prefix, hidden-state feature, probe score, calibration threshold and risk level, stop decision, generated tokens, final answer, correctness, latency, and probe overhead. Evaluate separately on in-distribution and shifted tasks, with full-generation and fixed-cap controls. The most useful production metric is not average token reduction alone, but token reduction conditional on accuracy and on the rate of unsafe early stops.

当服务系统拥有推理模型，并且必须把质量目标转化为节省 token 的策略时，本工作很有用。应记录模型修订版、提示族、每个被评估的思考前缀、隐藏状态特征、探针分数、校准阈值和风险水平、停止决策、生成 token、最终答案、正确性、延迟和探针开销。应在分布内与偏移任务上分别评估，并设置完整生成和固定上限对照。最有用的生产指标不是平均 token 减少本身，而是以准确率和不安全提前停止率为条件的 token 减少。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the method as online control, not as another confidence estimator. The central comparison is a calibrated stopping action versus a fixed cap, and the reasoning-tree interpretation explains why raw length is insufficient. Check what hidden layer and probe features are used, how the calibration set is separated, which risk is controlled, and whether probe cost is included in the serving ledger. The in-distribution and shifted results should be read separately: the gap between 60% and 20% token reduction is evidence that stopping policies require the same distributional caution as other test-time scaling methods.
应把方法读作在线控制，而不是另一个置信度估计器。核心比较是校准的停止动作与固定上限，而推理树解释了为何原始长度不足够。检查使用哪一层隐藏表示和哪些探针特征、校准集如何分离、控制哪种风险，以及探针成本是否被纳入服务成本账本。分布内与偏移结果应分开阅读：60% 与 20% token 减少之间的差距表明，停止策略与其他测试时扩展方法一样需要谨慎处理分布问题。
